purpose: select an FP64 operating learning rate for the four-stage interaction-order pilot using singleton numerical behavior only
candidate_grid_source: reuse the original chronology-blind Pythia scale LR grid without outcome-based expansion
selection_rule: choose the largest candidate learning rate for which all four singleton stages pass the frozen stability rule; if no candidate passes, stop without chronology testing

stage_randomness.rule: reset the stage-specific seed before every singleton execution so stochasticity cannot depend on learning-rate traversal order

portable_kernel_gate.reason: reuse the already validated portable CPU numerical controls for the FP64 four-stage calibration

schema_correction.failure_point: portable numerical configuration before tokenizer or model weights were loaded

next_step_if_selected: run a non-confirmatory four-stage K2/K3 pilot on the same previously used codebook before freezing the confirmation protocol
